name: AI Center of Excellence
short_description: A cross-functional team and repeatable operating model that helps an organization choose AI use cases, build them safely, protect the data around them and scale what proves useful, typically through governance, security and adoption.

evidence.quote: an AI center of excellence, often called an AI, Coe is a cross-functional team and a repeatable way of working
So please set up a COE first and then start rolling out your agents.
An AI center of excellence should provide standards, reusable assets, architecture patterns
